newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE THURSDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE THURSDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were near steady on Thursday, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was fairly good and seller interest limited.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1400 lbs - two pens 65.50; dressed basis 105.00, pen predominately Choice blacks 105.50, instance 104.50, ( weighted average 105.00 )
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs - pen 65.50; dressed basis mostly 105.00, few to 104.00, ( weighted average 104.81 )
Wk To Date- 51,700 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 94,200 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 124,700
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
NEBRASKA FEEDLOT WEEKLY SUMMARY - Week ending August 07, 1997 Confirmed - 51,700 Last Week - 94,200 Last Year - 124,700
Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were mostly $1.00 per cwt lower; dressed basis mostly $2.00 lower.

The week's total includes 9,800 previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sharply reduced boxed beef prices combined with a lower trending CME board to move slaughter cattle levels downward this week. This week's showlists were not "cleaned up", and a fair carryover is in the offing.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1400 lbs - Through the week 65.00-66.00, closing 65.00-65.50 ( weighted average 65.69 ); dressed basis through the week 105.00-106.00, closing mostly 105.00. ( weighted average 105.37 ).

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs - Through the week, 65.00-66.00, closing 65.00-65.50, ( weighted average ( 65.75 ); dressed basis through the week 105.00-106.00, closing mostly 105.00, ( weighted average 105.37).
